answer: A sybil farm replicating identities must fund separate stakes and pass distinct physical checks, so forging N participants costs N times the bond plus travel, making attacks economically irrational while an honest raven keeper earns attestations. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a randomized proof-of-location task, like photographing a sparrow near a tagged tundra marker, verified by three independent peers. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
